notes: V16.2: Kila kazi kwenye Programme iko kwenye category sahihi kufuata Bill ya BOQ: Preliminaries (Bill 1), Earthworks/Pavement/Surfacing/Vegetation/Desilting (Bill 2), Drainage Structures (Bill 3), Road Furniture & Safety (Bill 4, road signs, km posts, guard rails), Bridges (Bill 5 - river training, timber, steel covers, bolts, sand bags). River training ni Bridge works ya kiangazi.
